description.value: Small Victory Bakery is a family-owned artisan bakery and cafe with roots in an immigrant family's baking tradition, now operating four locations across the Vancouver area. The Brentwood outpost sits inside Brentwood Town Centre mall on Level 2, serving specialty breads, croissants, pastries, brunch, and lunch in an indoor setting. Touring cyclists stopping in Burnaby can pick up freshly baked loaves to carry on the road alongside specialty coffee and hot savory food.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 79m; stands (10 spaces) at 82m; stands (10 spaces) at 85m; stands (22 spaces, covered) at 97m. Total: 50 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Brentwood location at #1214-4580 Brentwood Boulevard as an active Small Victory Bakery cafe with indoor dining, takeout, and online ordering; OSM tags (indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=no, level=2) align with the website's description of an indoor mall setting on the second floor of Brentwood Town Centre. The menu page documents bread loaves available for takeaway and a full brunch/lunch hot-food program, supporting those two optional amenity calls. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific infrastructure is mentioned anywhere in OSM tags or website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM has no phone number listed; the Brentwood-specific phone (236-520-0708) was sourced from the website.
Category 'Groceries' (derived from shop=bakery) is imprecise — this is a bakery cafe, not a general grocery store.

Website footer displays the Mount Pleasant location address (388 West 6th Avenue, Vancouver) as the primary contact rather than the Brentwood location — this is a multi-location brand and footer contact may cause confusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bakery cafe with a confirmed address and web presence at the Brentwood Town Centre location in Burnaby.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery; the business is primarily a bakery cafe rather than a general grocery store. A 'Cafe' category would be more accurate, though it does sell packaged bread loaves for takeaway.

Hot food.detail: Brunch menu includes quiche, egg sandwiches, avocado toast, and oats; lunch menu includes sandwiches (turkey bacon avocado, chicken caesar, focaccia), power bowl, and seasonal soup

wow_evidence: family-owned artisan bakery... four locations across the Vancouver area
